items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: we used to wear these Candid Strike jackets like Nappy Lamar used to use on his show.

ctx.x: About Doc? Do you remember that one?

Oh, yeah, well, this happened, uh, in, in, uh, Rain, Louisiana. They had a, they show named Big, a banjo player. And he's one of these practice, uh, dear So that went on for two or three weeks. In my mind, I said, I've got to do something to get even with this guy. See, can he take a joke? So we were going crawfishing in this little town. And we got a little garter snake, about a foot long. I dug and put this garter snake in a sack. I knew right then when I'd seen this garter snake exactly what I was going to do…

He says, now we'll strike up a tune there. Old big boy run his hand in his pocket there to get this banjo pick. And this little garter snake had woke up by that time. And grabbed him right in the end of the... Oh, before this happened, we were ahead of the story. Doc had a... Doc had been on the stage, you know, talking about this formula where he had got it from.
